basic_info.description:
Welcome to 2310 Wawona Street, a spacious, detached and contemporary San Francisco Home.

Discover this beautifully designed home offering 2728 sq. ft. of spacious, refined living area in one of San Francisco's most charming and sought after neighborhoods.

The main level features a warm and welcoming entry, an extra-deep 800 sq. ft. garage and a bright, versatile multi-use family room, perfect as a guest suite, office, entertainment space or
a private in-law.

Upstairs, enjoy an expansive living room with a brick fireplace, open to the dining area and a sunlit kitchen and a breakfast room. 

The home features four generously sized bedrooms, including a primary suite with a remodeled bathroom, all bathed in an abundant natural light.

In this contemporary home, recent upgrades include: new flooring, lighting, kitchen appliances and bathrooms fixtures.

Ideally located across the street from Sigmund Stern Grove, near Lake Merced, Golf courses, Lakeshore Plaza, Stonestown Galleria and top-rated public and private schools.

The home offers unmatched comfort, convenience and enduring appeal.
